target.statement: ODK-means achieves average F1 = 1.000 for outlier detection at contamination rate p = 0.0025 (with α = 0.05), matching or beating Trimmed K-means and LOF.
target.dataset: Synthetic 4-cluster J-sphere data (Nk=300, r=3, s=8, σ2=0.1, p=0.0025), generated per Section S3

compute.basis: Synthetic data of ~1200 points in low dimension; ODK-means is O(N^2 J) preprocessing plus cheap K-means iterations, so a single table cell (10 replicates, 20 restarts) runs in minutes on CPU once the R code is adapted/verified.

blockers: Code repo exists but its completeness/state is unverified; simulation harness may need to be written from Section S3 description
Baseline comparisons (TKm, LOF) require R packages trimcluster/TClust/Rlof, but the target cell only needs ODK-means
Exact random seed / data-generation details not fully specified, so exact 1.000 may not reproduce bit-for-bit
title: Nonparametric framework for the definition, adaptive detection and probabilistic interpretation of outliers
